name: plantcase
description: Track plant pest and disease cases from photos, and see whether a problem is getting better.

interface.longDescription:
PlantCase turns a plant photo into a tracked case. Share a photo of a plant or crop in ChatGPT and say which plant it is. PlantCase saves the case, records the leading possibility with an honest level of confidence, and tells you which extra photos would help settle it. Come back later with a new photo of the same plant and ChatGPT can look at your earlier photos and history to say whether the problem is improving, staying the same or spreading.

What it does:
- Saves each photo and assessment as a case under your own account.
- Asks for the specific photos that would narrow the diagnosis.
- Compares new photos with earlier ones for the same plant.
- Notes treatments you tried and what happened.
- Shows general, category-level management options.
- Lets you delete one case or all your data at any time.

What it does not do: it covers pests and diseases only, not nutrients, soil or what to plant. A photo never gives a certain diagnosis, and PlantCase never gives pesticide doses or mixing instructions. For serious or large-scale problems, consult a local agronomist or extension service.
defaultPrompt: Here is a photo of my tomato leaf. What is wrong with it?
Show me my cases and where my tomato case stands.
What photos should I take to work out what is wrong with a leaf?
